use default
use System.Math

apply(operator: string, left: double, right: double) -> double =>
    case operator
    when "+" then left + right
    when "-" then left - right
    when "*" then left * right
    when "/" then left / right
    when "^" then Math.pow(left, right)
    else throw System.Exception("unknown operator {operator}")
    esac

let expression = "3 4 2 * 1 5 - 2 3 ^ ^ / +"

let stack = LIST()

pop() -> double =>
    (let top = stack[stack.count - 1]
     stack.remove_at(stack.count - 1)
     top)

show(token: string, action: string) is
    write_line("{token,5}  {action,-12}  {stack |> join(" ")}")
si

write_line("token  action        stack")

for token in expression.split([' ']) do
    if char.is_digit(token[0]) then
        stack.add(double.parse(token))

        show(token, "push")
    else
        let right = pop()
        let left = pop()

        stack.add(apply(token, left, right))

        show(token, "apply {token}")
    fi
od

write_line("")
write_line("result: {stack |> only()}")
